about: RANDBETWEEN (docs/specs/exsheet-functions ticket 15; ADR-0180): Windows Excel 16.0.20430.20092, en-GB; October 3 observations. Only the cases with one outcome are compared here; the samples (RANDBETWEEN-001, 003, 010, 011, 017) are the contract tests' (RandomTests). Fractional bounds and bounds past 2^53 are refused by decision, with Excel's outcome kept where it had one.
